note: Seals and Codes, the Courts of Whispers and Court Intrigue. Upgrade ids, branch ids and level counts are the engine's and never change. Operation ids stay the engine's; names, text and pictures are Erdae's. No text names the Hidden Council, Afrit or the Deliverer. Pictures are keys of the icon catalog.

upgrades.name: Market Informants
upgrades.desc: §LStall-keepers, carters and counting-house clerks tell us what the rival court buys, sells and owes.§!

upgrades.name: Barracks Informants
upgrades.desc: §LSutlers and armourers carry word of musters, marches and the mood of the ranks.§!

upgrades.name: Harbour Informants
upgrades.desc: §LPilots and quay-hands tell us which hulls sail, and with what cargo.§!

upgrades.name: Eyrie Informants
upgrades.desc: §LDragon-keepers and stable-hands tell us how many wings fly, and how well they are fed.§!

upgrades.name: Watchful Households
upgrades.desc: §LEvery steward, porter and cook is taught to remember strangers. Hostile deeds against the realm cost more to carry out.§!

upgrades.name: Root Out the Hidden
upgrades.desc: §LTrusted men learn to find those who plot in barns and cellars, and bring them to the magistrate.§!

upgrades.name: Copyists' Bribes
upgrades.desc: §LA purse in the right hand opens a guild's plan-chests for a single night.§!

upgrades.name: Rider Relays
upgrades.desc: §LA chain of fast riders and beacon keepers lets agents in the field strike together on a single signal.§!

upgrades.name: Secret Writing
upgrades.desc: §LLetters in lemon-juice and wax-blind scripts carry more word home, and are safer to carry.§!

upgrades.name: Fire-Pots and Pitch
upgrades.desc: §LAgents learn which barrel burns slow and which burns fast, and where to leave each.§!

upgrades.name: Hidden Poison
upgrades.desc: §LA vial sewn into a hem. A captured agent can end the questioning, and the questioners know it.§!

upgrades.name: Courtier Schools
upgrades.desc: §LA house in the capital where young folk learn manners, languages and the weight of a rumour. A further agent can be trained at a time.§!

upgrades.name: Knife-School
upgrades.desc: §LA few agents are taught to fight as hard as they hide.§!

upgrades.name: The Questioners
upgrades.desc: §LPatient men learn to draw more from captured agents, and to do it quietly.§!

upgrades.name: The Envoy's Tongue
upgrades.desc: §LAgents are taught to haggle over tolls, press envoys and win a quarrel with a smile.§!

upgrades.name: Whisper Campaigns
upgrades.desc: §LTales told in the right tavern at the right hour move factions faster than any edict.§!

upgrades.name: Found the Reading Room
upgrades.desc: §LA locked room under the chancery where seals are copied, wheels are turned and letters are read. Unlocks reading, and gives a first seal.§!

upgrades.name: Cipher Wheels in Hand
upgrades.desc: §LBrass wheels and ruled tables turn a night of guessing into an afternoon of reading.§!

upgrades.name: Learned Tables
upgrades.desc: §LScholars of the great schools compile every frequency of every tongue, and the Reading Room grows quicker.§!

upgrades.name: The School of Seals
upgrades.desc: §LCouriers are taught new knots, new wax and new words, so that stolen letters are harder to read.§!

upgrades.name: Learned Seals
upgrades.desc: §LScholars design seals no clerk could copy by eye, and a cipher that changes with the season.§!

tokens.name: Seat in the Household
tokens.desc: Holds a seat in the household of this court, and hears what is said there.

tokens.name: Name on the Roll
tokens.desc: Has a name on the muster rolls of this realm's host, and hears what is said in the ranks.

tokens.name: Berth Aboard
tokens.desc: Holds a berth in this realm's fleet, and hears what is said on its decks.

tokens.name: Place in the Roost
tokens.desc: Has a friend among this realm's dragon-keepers, and hears what is said in the roosts.

tokens.name: Hidden Friends
tokens.desc: Has friends among the unwilling subjects of this realm, who will act when asked.

QUIET_INTEL_NETWORK: Letting a web of informants sleep

operations.name: Bring Our Own Home
operations.desc: Free an agent of ours who sits in a rival's cells. A sound plan, a quiet door and a fast horse are all it takes.

operations.name: Ransom a Captain
operations.desc: A captain of ours is held by a rival lord. Agents may parley a ransom, storm the hold or smuggle him out in a carriage.

operations.name: Take Service at Court
operations.desc: An agent takes a place in a rival household and learns who comes and goes.

operations.name: Plant False Letters
operations.desc: A forged letter, planted where the enemy's seals will find it. Their captains march after phantoms.

operations.name: Steal the Cipher-Book
operations.desc: A courier's book of seals, copied in a night. The Reading Room does the rest.

operations.name: Enlist on the Roll
operations.desc: A name added to a rival's muster rolls, and a friend among his captains.

operations.name: Sign Aboard
operations.desc: A berth in a rival's fleet, and a quiet word with the boatswain.

operations.name: Befriend the Roost
operations.desc: A friend among a rival's dragon-keepers and riders, who talks over wine.

operations.name: Raise the Captains
operations.desc: The captains rise against their lord. Arms are sent ahead, and a few of the household look the other way.

operations.name: Arm the Hidden
operations.desc: Spears, shields and the knowledge to use them, handed to the unwilling subjects of a rival's holding.

operations.name: Find the Hidden
operations.desc: Friends among the unwilling, found in markets and chapels, who will remember a kindness.

operations.name: Seat a Friendly Regent
operations.desc: In a conquered land, a regent of our choosing governs in our name, and the folk obey him more readily than they would us.

operations.name: The Dawn Blow
operations.desc: Agents open a gate, cut the signal fires and guide the host in, so that war begins with the fort already ours.

operations.name: Copy a Guild's Secrets
operations.desc: Pattern-books copied by candlelight from a rival's guild halls.

operations.name: Spoil the Workshops
operations.desc: Pitch and fire in the halls of the rival's smiths and joiners.

operations.name: Cut the Roads
operations.desc: A bridge, a ford, a mountain road. The rival's carts and hosts go the long way round.

operations.name: Flood the Mines
operations.desc: Drowned shafts, spoiled granaries and blighted fields in the rival's lands.

operations.name: Copy the Smiths' Patterns
operations.desc: Arms, mail and engines drawn from a rival's armouries and copied.

operations.name: Copy the Shipwrights' Plans
operations.desc: Hull plans and rigging drawings, copied in a rival's yards.

operations.name: Copy the Roost-Lore
operations.desc: The old keepers' lore of feed and handling, copied from a rival's roosts.

phases.name: By the Border
phases.desc: The agents cross the march on foot, between two watch-posts, in the dark of the moon.
phases.outcome: Our agents slipped across the border and were not challenged.

phases.name: By a Night Ship
phases.desc: A small boat puts them ashore on a quiet beach, and sails again before dawn.
phases.outcome: A night ship set our agents ashore, and no watch saw her.

phases.name: By Wing
phases.desc: A dragon-keeper in our debt carries them over the border on a night flight.
phases.outcome: A rider set our agents down in a pasture far from any road.

phases.name: Through the Embassy
phases.desc: The agents travel openly with an envoy's train, and are lodged with the envoy's household.
phases.outcome: Our agents entered under the envoy's cloak, and the court was too polite to ask questions.

phases.name: Out by the Border
phases.desc: The agents walk home by the way they came, with the passes closing behind them.
phases.outcome: Our agents crossed the border safely.
phases.extra: Our agents were last seen at the border. They did not report back, and the watch-posts were loud that night.

phases.name: To Ground
phases.desc: The agents hide in a safe house in the capital until the hunt is over.
phases.outcome: Our agents lay hidden until the search had ended, and walked out as merchants.
phases.extra: Our agents went to ground, but a neighbour talked. The safe house was searched.

phases.name: A Sea Pickup
phases.desc: A fishing boat comes in on the night tide to take them off the shore.
phases.outcome: A boat took our agents off a lonely beach.
phases.extra: A boat came for our agents, but the shore was watched. Some did not return.

phases.name: Out by Wing
phases.desc: A rider lifts the agents out of a quiet field at midnight.
phases.outcome: A rider carried our agents out over the hills.
phases.extra: A rider came for our agents, but beasts were heard and archers were set. Some did not return.

phases.name: In Transit
phases.desc: Our agent is moved between two strongholds. The cart is stopped on a lonely road.
phases.outcome: Our agent was freed on the road, and the guards never found out which way he went.

phases.name: At the Camp
phases.desc: Our agent sits in a camp lock-up. A friend inside opens the gate.
phases.outcome: A gate opened from within, and our agent walked out.

phases.name: Hidden Tools
phases.desc: A file in a loaf, a key in a boot. The prisoner does the rest.
phases.outcome: Our agent had the tools he needed and made his own way out.

phases.name: A Ransom Parley
phases.desc: Envoys meet the captor and name a price. The ransom is paid in silver and in promises.
phases.outcome: The ransom was paid, and our captain came home on a borrowed horse.

phases.name: A Stormed Hold
phases.desc: The captain is held in a small keep. Agents, a few friends and a ladder will do.
phases.outcome: The hold was taken in a night, and the captain brought out through the postern.

phases.name: A Disguised Carriage
phases.desc: A closed carriage, a false pass and a driver who does not speak.
phases.outcome: The captain rode out in a lady's carriage, and no guard looked inside.

phases.name: A Bribed Clerk
phases.desc: A clerk who keeps the keys is short of silver and long on grudges.
phases.outcome: The clerk let us into the plan-chests and kept the door.

phases.name: A Charming Apprentice
phases.desc: An apprentice of ours takes a place beside the master, who is fond of a willing pupil.
phases.outcome: The apprentice copied the master's patterns, line by line.

phases.name: A Copied Plan-Chest
phases.desc: Night after night, a few sheets are taken, copied and returned before the yard wakes.
phases.outcome: A plan-chest was copied and returned with no seal broken.

phases.name: A Stolen Model
phases.desc: A small wooden model of the working, meant to be carried to the master's bench.
phases.outcome: A model was taken from the bench and carried across the border.

phases.name: A Talkative Foreman
phases.desc: A foreman who drinks too long on market days, and speaks too freely when he does.
phases.outcome: The foreman told us all he knew, and thought he was only complaining.

phases.name: A Bribe
phases.desc: A purse changes hands in a back room of an inn.
phases.outcome: The purse was taken and the debt noted.

phases.name: A Lover
phases.desc: A friendship of the heart gives an agent the ear of someone who matters.
phases.outcome: A fond word gave our agent the ear of a person with the keys.

phases.name: A Prisoner Turned
phases.desc: A captive taken in the last quarrel is offered his freedom for a few small favours.
phases.outcome: A prisoner chose his freedom, and now writes to us.

phases.name: A Believer
phases.desc: Someone who holds a creed of our people close to his heart, and little love for his own lord.
phases.outcome: A believer in our cause gave us his service freely.

phases.name: Pitch in the Halls
phases.desc: Casks of pitch carried in with the morning delivery, and a spark at midnight.
phases.outcome: The halls burned, and the fire could not be traced to a hand.

phases.name: Stalled Meetings
phases.desc: Quarrels at the guild table, over small things, until nothing is decided.
phases.outcome: The guild masters argued for a season and made nothing.

phases.name: A Broken Bridge
phases.desc: A pier cut half through, so that the bridge falls under the first heavy cart.
phases.outcome: The bridge fell under the first loaded wagon, and the stream took it.

phases.name: A Collapsed Gallery
phases.desc: Props cut in the old mine road, so that the roof comes down on the next shift.
phases.outcome: The old gallery fell, and the road beyond it is closed for a season.

phases.name: Stolen Signposts
phases.desc: Milestones turned about and signposts taken down, so that carters lose their way.
phases.outcome: Carters took the wrong road for a month, and many never arrived.

phases.name: Stranded Carts
phases.desc: Axles cut halfway through, so that a long train breaks down far from any smith.
phases.outcome: A train of carts broke down on the high road, and the goods were left to rot.

phases.name: A Burned Granary
phases.desc: A fire in the stores at harvest, set by someone who knew where the rats were.
phases.outcome: The granary burned to the ground, and the winter will be hard.

phases.name: Spoiled Mining Tools
phases.desc: Picks quenched too hot, so that they shatter on the first deep stone.
phases.outcome: The miners' picks broke one by one, and the shaft was left idle.

phases.name: Beacon Codes
phases.desc: Hill-top fires are lit in a pattern only the hidden know.
phases.outcome: A beacon code was agreed, and the hidden know which fires are ours.

phases.name: Carrier Birds
phases.desc: Pigeons taken to the unwilling villages, with a promise of more.
phases.outcome: The hidden have birds now, and will send word when they need us.

phases.name: A Briefing in a Barn
phases.desc: A night meeting among the straw, with a lantern shuttered.
phases.outcome: A meeting in a barn settled who will be asked and who will answer.

phases.name: Hidden Armouries
phases.desc: Spears and bows buried in a dry well, wrapped in oiled cloth.
phases.outcome: A hidden armoury was laid, and the hidden know where it lies.

phases.name: Arms Handed Out
phases.desc: A cart of hoes and scythes, each with an edge a smith has set.
phases.outcome: A cartload of tools with edges was shared out on a feast day.

phases.name: Teaching Drill
phases.desc: A few veterans of our host teach the hidden to hold a line.
phases.outcome: The hidden learned to march and stand, and will not break at the first charge.

phases.name: Joining the Bands
phases.desc: Agents ride with the hidden for a season, and show them the paths between the holds.
phases.outcome: Our agents rode with the hidden and showed them the safe paths.

phases.name: A Bribed Courier
phases.desc: The rider who carries the book is paid to lose it for a single night.
phases.outcome: The courier was paid, and the cipher-book was copied before dawn.

phases.name: A Raid on the Seal-Room
phases.desc: Three agents, a lantern and a stolen key take the seal-room while the clerks sleep.
phases.outcome: The seal-room was emptied and filled again before the clerks woke.

phases.name: A Wooed Scribe
phases.desc: A scribe who dines with an agent, and who likes to be asked about his work.
phases.outcome: The scribe talked all evening, and the agent remembered it all.

phases.name: A Smuggled Book
phases.desc: The cipher-book is borrowed under a merchant's cloak and carried out in a bale of cloth.
phases.outcome: The book was carried out in a bolt of cloth and carried back the same way.

phases.name: A Copied Wheel
phases.desc: A brass cipher wheel is pressed in wax, and a founder in our pay casts a twin.
phases.outcome: A twin of the cipher wheel now turns in our Reading Room.

phases.name: Decoy Camp-Fires
phases.desc: Hundreds of fires lit on a ridge where no host lies, to be counted by the enemy's scouts.
phases.outcome: A ridge of fires drew the enemy's scouts, and he counted a host that was never there.

phases.name: False Signal Horns
phases.desc: Horn calls from the wrong hills, sounded at the hours when an army would sound them.
phases.outcome: False horns called from the wrong hills, and the enemy answered them.

phases.name: Deliberate Leaks
phases.desc: A word dropped in a tavern frequented by clerks, which the enemy will pass up the line.
phases.outcome: A well-placed whisper reached the enemy's council as a warning.

phases.name: Market Rumours
phases.desc: Traders tell a tale of our muster at every fair, and the tale grows in the telling.
phases.outcome: The rumour ran the length of the high road and was believed.

phases.name: A Turned Agent
phases.desc: An enemy spy who works for us, and feeds his masters what we choose.
phases.outcome: The enemy's spy sent home a report that we wrote.

phases.name: Planted Proofs
phases.desc: Orders, tallies and a sealed letter, left where a careless officer will find them.
phases.outcome: The planted proofs were found, and carried to the enemy council as truth.

phases.name: A Released Prisoner
phases.desc: A captive freed with a head full of what he was told, and a plausible story of how he escaped.
phases.outcome: A freed prisoner carried our story home, and swore it was true.

phases.name: A Planning Council
phases.desc: Our envoys sit with the chosen regent and sketch how the land will be governed.
phases.outcome: The regent and our envoys settled how the land would be ruled.

phases.name: Training a Garrison
phases.desc: The regent's own guard is drilled in our ways, and sworn to him and to us.
phases.outcome: The regent has a guard that answers to him, and to us.

phases.name: Friendly Captains
phases.desc: Captains of the old order are won over one by one with titles and with promises.
phases.outcome: The old captains accepted the regent, and brought their companies.

phases.name: Scouting the Gate
phases.desc: Agents walk every wall and note every sentry, every hour and every lamp.
phases.outcome: Every gate was walked and written down, and the plan was drawn.

phases.name: Marking the Targets
phases.desc: Chalk on doors, coloured ribbons on posts. The host will know what to take first.
phases.outcome: The targets were marked in a way that only the host could read.

phases.name: Cutting the Signal Fires
phases.desc: On the night of the blow, every beacon on the border is put out before it is lit.
phases.outcome: The beacons were put out one by one, and the realm slept on.

phases.name: Guiding the Host
phases.desc: Agents wait at every crossroads with a lantern and show the vanguard the paths.
phases.outcome: The vanguard found its way through the dark by our lanterns.

phases.name: Seizing the Bridges
phases.desc: At the signal, the agents and a few friends hold the bridges against the garrison.
phases.outcome: The bridges were held until the host came up.

phases.name: The Captains Meet
phases.desc: In a hunting lodge, far from the court, the captains agree who will rise and when.
phases.outcome: The captains met in secret and swore to rise together.

phases.name: The Standard Is Raised
phases.desc: A banner, new-sewn, is hung from a captain's tower, and the host splits in two.
phases.outcome: The captains raised their own standard, and the host divided.

category.name: Night Raid
category.desc:
§HNight raids§!
Small bands slip behind the enemy's line in the dark, to burn what he stores, free those he holds and be gone by dawn.
category.fluff: §LA few fast riders and a lantern.§!

types.name: Ransom a Captain by Night
types.desc: A band slips into the hold where an enemy keeps one of our captains and brings him out by night.

types.name: Burn the Depot
types.desc: A band falls on a depot of the enemy and burns the stores before the guard can wake.

types.name: Fire the Granary
types.desc: A band finds the enemy's granary on the edge of a town and sets it alight.
